The**Hellenic Ministry of Foreign Affairs**([Greek](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greek_language):Υπουργείο Εξωτερικών,[romanized](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romanization_of_Greek):*Ypourgeío Exōterikṓn*) is a[government department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_(government_department))of[Greece](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greece), headed by the Minister for Foreign Affairs. The ministry has its headquarters in[Athens](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Athens).

The incumbent minister is[Giorgos Gerapetritis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Giorgos_Gerapetritis)in the[Second Cabinet of Kyriakos Mitsotakis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_Cabinet_of_Kyriakos_Mitsotakis).
